# Badge

Displays compact metadata, status, or categorization. Opt-in counts are rendered with the shared Counter primitive.

- **Import:** `import { Badge } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Components
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/components-badge--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { Badge, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function BadgeExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Badge variant="default">Badge</Badge>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Badge

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `BadgeProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, VariantProps<typeof badgeVariants>`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `counter`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `icon`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.
- `showCounter`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.
- `size`: `"sm" | "lg" | "default" | "icon" | null`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `variant`: `"link" | "default" | "destructive" | "outline" | "secondary" | "ghost" | null`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the 263 attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
